Matches of the Week · GW5
Featured Match

The unbeaten and the unpredictable

Home
skoeiboy
2–2 · 394 pts
vs
Away
brendog2814
4–0 · 431 pts

brendog2814 is the only team yet to lose and the only one to have passed 140 in a week, and he arrives against the hardest side in the league to forecast. skoeiboy has already posted both the highest total of the season and one of the lowest, in consecutive rounds, and nothing in between has settled the question of which is the real one. Four weeks is not much to go on, but it is enough to say that one of these teams turns up every week and the other decides on the day. The unbeaten run has not met anything like this yet — every opponent so far has handed him a quiet afternoon.

Featured Match

The champion and the newcomer

Home
erozier
1–3 · 313 pts
vs
Away
mdropkin
3–1 · 380 pts

erozier won this league last season and has one win from four in this one. mdropkin had never played a week of it before August and has three. That is the whole fixture. The title defence has been undone less by bad luck than by bad weeks — he has been beaten on points by most of the field most rounds, and the record is an honest reflection for once. Across from him is a manager whose worst afternoon would be a good one for half the league. A win here puts the newcomer level with the leaders; a loss drops the champion to the bottom of the table and makes the rest of the autumn a salvage job.
